generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Lease-only compliance car (California, Oregon, some eastern states; about 1,100 units). 20 kWh Toshiba SCiB lithium-titanate pack, about 4 h on 240 V; no DC fast charging found for the US car. Production ended mid-2014. US only (no NRCan rows). Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Honda_Fit_EV
